# V2.3 acceptance evidence

This file records release evidence, not aspirational support. A CI automated compile
does not substitute for the human visual gate required by `finalize_qa.py`.

Current status: accepted. The three P1 contract gaps found in PR #2 review
(dual-field MinerU tables, mixed scanned-page detection, and the DOCX-audit freeze
chain) are repaired and independently reverified. The accepted implementation code
is `50f526b9edbc8417cd1c336af52651803f6a159b`; the reviewed evidence head is
`d666febd99ceae776a97c6544cb971e37504f974`. The documentation-only closeout then
passed the same required CI before PR #2 was marked Ready and squash merged to
`main`. The six current full-resolution renders remain byte-identical to the human-
inspected set. Automated artifacts still intentionally stop final QA until a visual
review is bound to their exact current PDF bytes.

## Final reviewer acceptance

- Review result on 2026-08-14: passed with no remaining blocking findings. All three
  review threads were resolved only after the user explicitly authorized release.
- Rotation evidence was checked independently, not only through the committed
  regression. The same A4 rectangle covering 60% of a page measured exactly `0.6`
  at 0, 90, 180, and 270 degrees. The same four rotations with a non-zero CropBox also
  remained exactly `0.6`.
- The four-page 90-degree/no-OCR import was rebuilt and stopped at
  `manual_source_review_required` with page 4 native `1`, adapter `0`, raster `0.6`,
  and document native ratio `0.75`. Its source audit returned the same non-passed
  status without integrity failures.
- The audit was tested against self-consistent forgery attempts. Replacing `0.6` with
  `0.0` and rebinding evidence, manifest, and IR hashes still failed because the
  frozen origin PDF recomputed `0.6`. Keeping `0.6` but removing the manual-review
  reason likewise failed the independent reason/status boundary.
- The downloaded academic DOCX contains one native Word table and embeds the table
  screenshot bytes (`6684b51a1a3c4475b6e7a4c5e5884e73adf5dff857b0e79341cb828d126ed1e7`),
  so neither half of the official dual-field table shape is lost. The DOCX audit,
  compile audit, and actual DOCX bytes retain matching bindings; the post-audit DOCX
  mutation and stale/schema-downgrade regressions pass.
- Independent local matrix: legacy 19/19; Profile 6/6; MinerU 16/16; IR/source 5/5;
  output 6/6; DOCX suite passed; visual/freeze 8/8; all three Profile CLI validations,
  `compileall`, dependency `pip check`, and `git diff --check` passed.
- Final reviewed-head run:
  [31809114971](https://github.com/littlemuu/make-bilingual-study-pdf/actions/runs/31809114971),
  with `self-test` and `automated-forward` both successful. Downloaded artifact
  SHA-256: `a909d7ab0a9eb621589f46030a8f2275a0899039aaf64c6bc742fb1ee908dce7`.
  Both Profile chains have all automated gates passed; their six render SHA-256 values
  match the previously inspected set exactly. No `visual-review.json` was invented,
  and finalization remains correctly blocked on that human gate.
- The closeout commit changes only this acceptance record and `PROJECT_HANDOFF.md`.
  Its required CI success and final merge SHA are recorded canonically on PR #2,
  avoiding a self-referential documentation commit.
- Private complex paper/lecture inputs and the private CS336 90-page baseline remain
  unavailable. Public synthetic fixtures are not represented as substitutes.

## Frozen support boundary

- Verified fixture version: MinerU `3.4.4`
- Accepted backend: stable 3.x `_backend: "pipeline"`
- Accepted structured input: legacy flat `*_content_list.json` plus matching
  `*_middle.json` and hash-equal `*_origin.pdf`
- Rejected: VLM, hybrid, office, prereleases, other major versions,
  `content_list_v2.json`-only, and 4.x `structured_content.json`
- Import behavior: consumes only frozen output; never installs/runs MinerU or downloads
  a model
- Official schema reference reviewed 2026-08-14:
  <https://opendatalab.github.io/MinerU/reference/output_files/>
- Official 3.4.4 release reviewed 2026-08-14:
  <https://github.com/opendatalab/MinerU/releases/tag/mineru-3.4.4-released>
- Current MinerU license reviewed 2026-08-14:
  <https://github.com/opendatalab/MinerU/blob/master/LICENSE.md>

## Public fixture

`tests/fixtures/mineru/pipeline-3.4.4/` is original synthetic repository material.
`fixture-manifest.json` freezes its schema source, file hashes, expected item/node/
disposition counts, and normalized contract hash. `../generate_fixtures.py` recreates
the native source/origin PDF deterministically from the committed synthetic content.
No paper, lecture, MinerU program output, model, or weight is committed.

The native fixture has 22 content items and 32 normalized nodes, including separate
structured and visual nodes for the official dual-field table shape. Its real Poppler
source audit reaches five-gram coverage `0.9825` against the unchanged `0.95` gate.
The scan fixture is expected to stop at `manual_source_review_required`.

## Required test commands

```text
python scripts/self_test.py
python scripts/v23_profile_test.py
python scripts/v23_mineru_test.py
python scripts/v23_ir_source_test.py
python scripts/v23_output_test.py
python scripts/v23_docx_test.py
python scripts/v23_visual_gate_test.py
python scripts/pipeline.py validate-profile assignment-en-zh
python scripts/pipeline.py validate-profile academic-paper-en-zh
python scripts/pipeline.py validate-profile lecture-notes-en-zh
```

The GitHub `automated-forward` job additionally installs Pandoc, LibreOffice Writer,
Fontconfig, Noto CJK/core fonts, and Poppler. It runs both new Profiles through frozen
import, independent source audit, deterministic synthetic translations, output audit,
DOCX build/audit, LibreOffice PDF conversion, full render decode, CJK/font/A4 checks,
and contact-sheet creation. It must also prove that finalization remains blocked until
a human visual review is recorded.

## Current rotation-safe raster follow-up record

- Code under test: `50f526b9edbc8417cd1c336af52651803f6a159b`
- Base: `main@e69fd57de4b94ff00bc3f14f137ddbcc12e5d4e6`
- Page-local contract: PyMuPDF's `get_image_info()` rectangles are in the unrotated
  page coordinate system. The importer transforms each through `page.rotation_matrix`
  before clipping it to the rotation-aware `page.rect`; the union area is divided by
  that same rectangle's area. Overlaps remain counted once. A page below the Profile's
  native-text threshold whose raster coverage is at least `0.5` is
  `manual_source_review_required`, independently of MinerU content or OCR length.
- The importer records method `pymupdf-rotated-image-bbox-union-v2`, its threshold,
  and every page ratio. `audit_source.py` reopens the frozen origin PDF and calls the
  same rotation-safe evidence routine, then verifies the reason/status boundary and
  fails if self-reported evidence differs.
- Rotation regression evidence: the four-page mixed document retains three native
  pages. Page 4 is an A4 `612 x 792` page rotated 90 degrees, containing native page
  number `4`, no MinerU OCR node, and an unrotated image rectangle covering 60% of
  the source page. The rotation-aware page rectangle is `792 x 612`; the computed
  raster ratio is exactly `0.6`, native count is `1`, adapter count is `0`, and the
  document native ratio is `0.75`. The page records only
  `large_raster_without_native_oracle`, and both import and source audit stop at
  `manual_source_review_required` with no audit integrity failure.
- Local verification: the new rotation regression and the other 14 non-generator-hash
  MinerU cases passed; legacy self-test 19/19; Profile 6/6; IR/source 5/5; output 6/6;
  DOCX suite passed; visual/freeze 8/8; all three Profile CLI validations,
  `compileall`, dependency `pip check`, and `git diff --check` passed. This Windows
  checkout's full MinerU command still reports only the known CRLF working-tree hash
  mismatch for the LF-frozen fixture generator; the Linux job below verifies the
  repository bytes and all 16 tests.
- GitHub Actions run: [31808652590](https://github.com/littlemuu/make-bilingual-study-pdf/actions/runs/31808652590),
  `self-test` and `automated-forward` passed on Ubuntu 24.04. The deterministic
  baseline includes MinerU 16/16 and the frozen generator hash.
- Automated forward report SHA-256:
  `9e70a8f9ae4966e0e3e9574575c4a8943525ddefc8466e799033f625d500c86e`
- Both automated Profile chains report `passed`, three A4 pages, complete renders and
  contact sheets, and `finalization_without_visual_review: blocked`. All six render
  SHA-256 values exactly match the previously inspected values recorded below; CI did
  not manufacture a human `passed` review or final QA report.
- Private complex paper/lecture inputs and the private CS336 90-page baseline remain
  unavailable; public fixtures are not represented as substitutes.

## Visual-defect closure

The first automated artifact passed machine gates but failed the required human review:
table HTML appeared literally, two references collapsed into one line, and lecture
definition/theorem/proof/example anchors lacked distinct callouts. The fixes added native
Pandoc/Word tables, list-preserving output and PDF audit candidates, source-only byline
classification, and scoped anchor-only callouts with non-absorption failure tests.

Three subsequent failed CI runs were retained as useful evidence rather than rerun away:

- [31783926253](https://github.com/littlemuu/make-bilingual-study-pdf/actions/runs/31783926253):
  exposed Pandoc splitting ordinary raw HTML into multiple AST blocks
- [31784210653](https://github.com/littlemuu/make-bilingual-study-pdf/actions/runs/31784210653):
  exposed the absence of host-template `Table Grid` on Linux
- [31784411191](https://github.com/littlemuu/make-bilingual-study-pdf/actions/runs/31784411191):
  reached PDF and exposed LibreOffice's extracted bullet character in reference auditing

The passing run above verifies all three defects through the real Linux DOCX/PDF chain.
